svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three parts: a folded channel, a bottom cover and two end caps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Channel: blank 716 x 346 mm (check the developed length with a test

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bend). Fold a 10 mm lip, the 128 mm back wall, the 70 mm top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 128 mm front wall and a 10 mm lip; both lips point inward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head cut-outs: four, 128 x 50 mm, two in each wall, centred 200 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the middle and 65 mm up from the underside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back wall: two 9 mm holes on the middle, 45 and 85 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cover: 70 x 716 mm, a 16 mm gland hole 60 mm from the middle on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the road-side half; M4 screws into rivet nuts in the lips.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End caps: 70 x 130 mm with 15 mm flanges folded in on three sides;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rivet into the channel ends. Kerb-end cap: 22 mm pilot light hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the back wall bolts flat to its saddle; the cover comes off for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the two bolts. Check: square, cover seats on both lips.
